title: Where the time goes in real agent use of Qwen3.6-35B-A3B
setup: Read-only analysis of the llama-server log of the production router during normal use by coding agents (461 requests to Qwen3.6, a few days of work). Nothing was changed to take the measurement.

qwen36.long_generation_share: The 8% of requests that generate 1,000-3,000 tokens (almost all reasoning) produce 42% of all generated tokens.

source: Internal report 26 (2026-10-23). The 50.9 tok/s average is before the configuration changes of this repository.
